additional_info.subject: Re: [EXT]ID0477787-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP/S5 170003674] Charging issue CRM:02889001088
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support,
We are experiencing a recurring issue with the charger that requires the CPO to manually reboot the unit daily, and in some cases several times per day, in order to restore operation.
We have attached the diagnostic file for your review.
In the logs, we repeatedly see the following error:
abort for request: http://10.20.17.21/v2/status
AbortError: This operation was aborted
This appears to be an internal communication failure (local IP 10.20.17.21), not a backend connectivity issue. OCPP communication and external network connectivity remain stable during these events.
The pattern is consistent:
Charger enters fault state
Charging becomes unavailable
Manual reboot restores operation
Fault reappears within ~24 hours (sometimes sooner)
Based on the log analysis, this suggests a recurring internal communication timeout between the main controller and an internal subsystem.
We kindly ask you to:
Confirm which internal component corresponds to 10.20.17.21.
Advise whether this is a known firmware issue.
Confirm if a firmware update is recommended.
Assess whether hardware inspection (e.g., internal Ethernet harness, SCB/controller board, power module communication board) is required.
The current situation is not sustainable, as daily manual intervention is required to keep the charger operational.
We look forward to your analysis and proposed corrective action.
Juuso Englund | Senior Technical Support Specialist | Virta Ltd.
Energiakuja 3, FI-00180 Helsinki
www.virta.global
